method_appraisal.adjustment_discrepancy: Original multivariate footnote includes age and sex. Correction footnote omits them; both include weight change during follow-up. Preserve the textual discrepancy; do not silently harmonize.
method_appraisal.causal_limit: Post-randomization weight-change adjustment prevents automatically interpreting the reported model as a total causal assignment effect.
method_appraisal.censoring: Cox follow-up ends at last visit, death or diabetes diagnosis; no recovered event/covariate histories for Cox refit or competing-risk observation model.
method_appraisal.correction: Separate Reus analysis excludes nonrandomized second household members. It does not supply the unavailable multicenter Annals correction.
method_appraisal.diagnosis: Annual fasting glucose or OGTT with confirmation. Exact first-positive versus confirmation event dating is unresolved.
method_appraisal.original_locators: Methods sec5/sec6; results sec7 first two paragraphs; original Table2 footnote
method_appraisal.overlap: Combined, VOO and nuts contrasts share participants/control; original and corrected fits overlap. No independent pooling or inferred joint covariance.

population_and_offered_food_context.interpretation: Offered food amounts are not consumed doses. Annual diagnosis with confirmation; exact event-dating and competing-risk mapping unresolved. Context only, not an engine input.

source_locators.correction: Body household assignment correction; Table3 tblfn2/tblfn4

review: Codex-assisted source appraisal and separate Codex critique; external human expert review pending

rights.correction: Publisher educational, not-for-profit, unaltered-use permission per XML; no unrestricted raw redistribution asserted
rights.distribution: Full XML articles remain fetch-only in ignored local storage. Commit factual estimates, receipts and original Demeter transforms only.

arm_headers.nuts: MedDiet with nuts vs. control diet
arm_headers.voo: MedDiet with VOO vs. control diet

table_selection.selection: All two overall models and three contrasts, irrespective of direction or null inclusion. Subgroup rows not extracted or pooled in this protocol.
table_selection.source_comparison: Compare the three original-row point/CI tuples in correction Table3 against original Table2; retain disagreement and fail source reproduction if not exact.
table_selection.uncertainty: Retain reported intervals without turning them into a sampling distribution; shared participants/control and original/corrected analyses are dependent, with joint covariance unavailable.
table_selection.unit: dimensionless adjusted Cox hazard ratio for first incident diabetes
